statement: Newegg lists a new PNY NVIDIA H100 80GB HBM3 card in stock at $34,879.00 sold by Newegg, with configuration options from $29,500.00 to $34,879.00, as fetched 2026-09-06.
why: A retail listing gives a visible, checkable price for a single H100 board on the open channel, but this page shows no earlier price, so it is a level rather than a move.

impact.mechanism: Open-channel hardware pricing is a confirmation overlay on secondary-market accelerator value; with no stated baseline it does not indicate direction.

evidence.excerpt: In-stock listing: 'PNY NVIDIA H100 Graphic Card', Price: '$34,879.00', Condition: New, Seller: Newegg

confidence.basis: Single retail listing page with no publication date; fetch date used, and retail list price may not reflect volume transaction prices.

dispersion: Same page shows H100 variants at $30,948.99 (Supermicro NVL, out of stock) and $30,999.00 (NVIDIA H100 NVL, out of stock) against the in-stock PNY card at $34,879.00.
